text:
sara_ae: Quick: AtlasRx POC kickoff. They need SSE streaming (python), in-stream function/tool calls to their case API (sync POSTs + idempotency), strict JSON schema output, and EU data residency. Budget hard cap ~12k/mo. Can we confirm SDK debug tips + any immediate blockers?

 tom_se: I can take integration. Question: do they want retries handled by our runtime or by their webhook? Also latency target?

 sara_ae: They want our runtime to surface retries but webhook must be idempotent. Target 95p <= 300ms.

 lina_devex: I'll prepare a minimal sample repo (python + node) and a one-page runbook. SDK debug: set REDWOOD_SDK_TRACE=1 and run harness with --live-debug. Short python snippet: 
```
from redwood_sdk import Client
import os
cli = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'), enable_trace=True)
with cli.stream(model='redwood-medium', transport='sse', response_format='jsonschema', top_level_schema='{"type":"object"}') as s:
  for ev in s:
    print(ev)
```
Also include a --proxy-eu flag to force eu-west routing for residency tests.

 claire_sre: For EU residency recommend Dedicated eu-west or Private. Hosted EU routing can work for POC but has weaker KMS/audit controls. Cost note: hosted estimate ~$4k-6k/mo; small Dedicated to meet 300ms 95p ~9k-11k/mo.

 tom_se: Implementation notes: (1) Emit tool calls as explicit tool_invocation events with {call_id, idempotency_key, payload} so we can trace retries. (2) For streaming+function-calls, prefer synchronous webhook path with immediate ack event. (3) During POC set batching.window_ms low (5ms) and keep max_tokens small to avoid bill spikes.

 sara_ae: Pricing ask: can you sketch numbers for 10k req/day at ~60 tokens/req?

 claire_sre: Rough hosted cost ~4.5k/mo on quantized model. Dedicated small pool to meet latency ~10k/mo before discounts. I'll follow up with a short calc.

 infra-bot: Ticket POC-ATLAS-2026-11 created: "AtlasRx SSE POC - streaming + toolcalls + EU residency" assigned to @lina_devex, @tom_se.

 lina_devex: ETA EOD tomorrow for sample app + checklist. Will include: python/node examples, SSE harness with proxy-eu, tool-call emulator, schema validator, short security answer (data flows, KMS, retention, audit logs), and a POC cost sketch.

 tom_se: I'll add a short ops note for the customer: set idempotency header, monitor token dashboard, set $1k/day alert during POC.

 sara_ae: Perfect, thanks! :thumbsup:
